facts.text: I am organizing my writing projects and want a tool to track my progress and deadlines.
I use Scrivener for my short story.
I use Google Docs for my journal entries and poetry.
I want a separate tool to track my overall writing progress, such as a dashboard showing how many words I have written and how many poems I have finished.
I think I will try out WriteTrack.
I started my journal on January 15th.
I use my journal for morning pages.
I use my journal for occasional poetry.
I use morning pages to clear my mind and get my thoughts down on paper.
I use morning pages to reflect on my progress and goals, especially with my writing projects.
I usually let my thoughts flow freely onto the page when writing.
Sometimes I have something specific I want to write about before I start writing.
I use my writing to get my thoughts out of my head and onto paper.
I use my writing to process my emotions and reflect on my experiences.
My morning pages have influenced my creative writing projects.
Sometimes I write about a theme or idea in my morning pages and later revisit it to develop it into a poem or a scene in my short story.
My morning pages help me develop my characters and story ideas.
My morning pages help me explore my characters' thoughts, feelings, and motivations in a free-form way.
I wrote a poem on February 2nd that was inspired by a winter walk I took in a nearby park.
My February 2nd poem was originally a morning page entry that I later revised and expanded into a full poem.
